title: External Adapters Module
summary: This module provides various adapter implementations that bridge DSPy modules and signatures with Language Models (LMs), handling prompt formatting, response parsing, and specialized LM interactions.

nodes.label: Base Adapter
nodes.title: dspy.adapters.base.Adapter
nodes.description: Defines the core interface for transforming DSPy inputs and signatures into LM calls and parsing LM outputs, including native LM feature integration.

nodes.label: BAML Adapter
nodes.title: dspy.adapters.baml_adapter.BAMLAdapter
nodes.description: Specializes in rendering complex Pydantic models into a compact, human-readable schema for LMs, improving structured output generation and token efficiency.

nodes.label: Two-Step Adapter
nodes.title: dspy.adapters.two_step_adapter.TwoStepAdapter
nodes.description: Orchestrates a two-stage process: a main LM generates a response, then a smaller LM extracts structured data from the raw output using a ChatAdapter.

nodes.label: Language Model (LM)
nodes.title: dspy.clients.base_lm.BaseLM
nodes.description: External language model providing text generation capabilities, used by adapters for processing requests.

nodes.label: DSPy Signature
nodes.title: dspy.signatures.signature.Signature
nodes.description: Defines the input and output fields, instructions, and constraints for an LM call, guiding adapter behavior.

nodes.label: LM Request
nodes.title: dspy.core.types.LMRequest
nodes.description: Standardized request object containing messages and parameters sent to a Language Model.

nodes.label: LM Response
nodes.title: dspy.core.types.LMResponse
nodes.description: Standardized response object received from a Language Model, containing generated text and metadata.

nodes.label: Chat Adapter
nodes.title: dspy.adapters.chat.ChatAdapter
nodes.description: A specialized adapter for chat-based interactions, used internally by TwoStepAdapter for structured data extraction.

nodes.label: Pydantic BaseModel
nodes.title: pydantic.BaseModel
nodes.description: External data models used for defining structured data, particularly leveraged by BAMLAdapter for schema generation.

nodes.label: DSPy Input Data
nodes.title: DSPy Input
nodes.description: The initial structured input data provided to a DSPy module, which is then processed by an adapter.

nodes.label: Parsed Output Data
nodes.title: Parsed Output
nodes.description: The structured output data produced by the adapter after successfully parsing the Language Model's response.

groups.label: Core Adapters
groups.title: Core Adapter Implementations
groups.description: The primary adapter classes defining how DSPy interacts with Language Models.

groups.label: LM Integration
groups.title: Language Model Integration
groups.description: Components related to interacting with external Language Models.

groups.label: Data Structures
groups.title: Key Data Structures
groups.description: Important data formats and definitions used across the adapter layer.

groups.label: Input/Output Flow
groups.title: Adapter Input and Output
groups.description: Represents the flow of data into and out of the adapter system.
